note: Every religious string in the sibling *.json files is copied verbatim from the sources below. Nothing was paraphrased, generated, or invented. Texts are preserved exactly as supplied (leading/trailing whitespace trimmed only).

sources.numbering: 1-42 exactly as numbered upstream (the source uses 42 entries; not forced to 40)
sources.reference_format: Hadith {n}, 40 Hadith an-Nawawi (matches sunnah.com Reference line)
sources.narrator: not isolated upstream (kept inline in text); stored NULL
sources.grade: upstream grades arrays are empty; stored NULL, never invented
sources.verification: Arabic opening of no. 1 matches https://sunnah.com/nawawi40:1; counts 42/42 cross-checked against the same collection page family

sources.numbering: 1-40 exactly as numbered upstream; kept fully separate from Nawawi
sources.narrator: not isolated upstream (kept inline in text); stored NULL
sources.grade: upstream grades arrays are empty; stored NULL, never invented

sources.source_name: AhmedBaset/hadith-json (scraped from Sunnah.com per its README)
sources.numbering: global 1-1896 = concatenation of by_chapter files in order [introduction, 1..19]; PROVEN against https://sunnah.com/riyadussalihin:1 (first row, intentions) and https://sunnah.com/riyadussalihin:1896 (last row, Suhaib/Jannah, Book of Forgiveness). The single-file by_book dump uses scrape order and MUST NOT be used for numbering.
sources.narrator: taken from upstream english.narrator; 11 rows have none upstream and store NULL
sources.grade: not supplied upstream; stored NULL, never invented
sources.chapter: upstream coarse bucket English title (20 buckets); Arabic bucket titles not carried into rows

sources.source_name: curated داخل-repo from the three datasets above (no external text)
sources.numbering: curated positions 1-20; originals preserved in source_collection/source_number
sources.selection_rule: first 10 Nawawi (the author's own front-loaded order) + first 5 Qudsi + first 5 Riyad; rows copied byte-identically (verified by script)
